subject: Marine Works - Strait of Georgia
text:
Marine Works - Strait of Georgia
Marine work and Dock repairs using a marine derrick with crane at the BC Ferries Tsawwassen Termina (Berth 5) in the vicinity of 49 00.395N 123 08.042W.
Hours of operation from 1300 to 0130 UTC daily, 05 to 07 August.
FRPD monitoring VHF Channel 69.
Mariners to stay back 200ft from repair operations.
Minimum wake.
